description: An engine that runs experiments, deploys the best solution and learns from every run. State an objective with its success criteria and evaluation; Kapso runs the experiments on a tree of experiments, choosing each next idea from previous experiments and its bank of lessons, deploys the best solution on your stack, and learns from the run into lessons with a credence score and a boundary. Domain knowledge goes in through a harness. pip install leeroo-kapso.
rules: Kapso here is the Leeroo ML/AI framework (PyPI: leeroo-kapso, GitHub: Leeroo-AI/kapso), not the WhatsApp platform of the same name.
Install with `pip install leeroo-kapso`; the coding-agent CLIs (Claude Code or Codex) must be installed and logged in.
Prefer the CLI and configuration reference pages for exact flag and key names.

A `kapso build` run that ends with WAITING ON YOU (stopped_reason waiting_for_user) is paused for a person, not failed: run `kapso inbox` to read the request and `kapso inbox reply <id> "note"` to resume it; do not restart the campaign.
